title: register-conjecture input
description: One human conjecture, the signature it applies to, and the observation that would settle it. A conjecture without an expected observation cannot be tested and is refused.

conjecture.description: The claim in one sentence, stated so a reader can disagree with it.

expected_observation.description: What would be observed if the conjecture is true. Without this the conjecture is a wish.

op.description: Operator the conjecture is about; empty for a device-wide claim.

signature_tags.description: Tags from docs/vocabulary.md section 3, or a signature class, or plateau.

metric.description: Canonical metric the conjecture predicts to move. One of tooling/rsi/metrics.py.

microbench.description: Microbenchmark that isolates the mechanism, when one exists.

related_experiments.description: Past experiments that may already answer the conjecture; checking them is cheaper than new device time.
